'''Rasche''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], he was stationed in the [[Imperial base camp]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Rasche first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Sith Warrior class trainer on Ilum.<ref name="TOR" />
